adaptations.checkout: Reuses the block rules: server-owned prices, hosted checkout, and captured-payment confirmation. Reimplemented through the starter HTTP client in lib/pramaan.ts; no SDK. Added row-locked holds, durable retry keys, exact currency and amount checks, and late-payment review.
adaptations.theme: Uses the bundled starter fonts and theme tokens rather than remote fonts. Gather adds event cards and responsive organiser forms in app/theme.css.
adaptations.password-reset: Reuses request/reset forms and one-time-proof rules. The unchanged accounts module owns verification, reset and sessions; app/password-reset and the starter reset-password form use the platform email module.
adaptations.roles: Reuse lib/roles/http.ts byte for byte: bounded same-origin JSON requests and no-cache error responses. Roles are checked with the unchanged accounts module; event queries enforce attendee ownership on the server.
